machine.cpu: Intel Core i7-9700K, 8 cores, 95 W TDP

meter: nvidia-smi power.draw (board power, instantaneous on Turing, +/- 5 W) and utilization.gpu every 100 ms; energy by trapezoids over the run, minus the mean idle baseline sampled just before it
gate: each run starts only with the GPU below 5 % and no Blender process on it
scaling_rule: equal energy per item on the 1 kW reference server (equal performance per watt): items per server-hour = 1,000 Wh / Wh per item, with Wh per item = (GPU above idle + CPU share) / items

embeddings.cpu_method: RAPL not readable without root; Ollama's CPU seconds above baseline x 11.9 W per busy core (95 W TDP / 8 cores, stated, not metered)
embeddings.text_set: 20000 synthetic texts of 40 words (seed 2025, measure_ai.texts), batches of 64

inference.cpu_method: RAPL not readable without root; Ollama's CPU seconds above baseline x 11.9 W per busy core (95 W TDP / 8 cores, stated, not metered)
inference.settings: think off, temperature 0, seed 7, up to 256 tokens, one request at a time
